about:
# WoWClearance

[![Licence](https://img.shields.io/badge/Licence-Source--Available-blue?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/powerfulqa/WoWClearance/blob/master/LICENSE)
[![Client](https://img.shields.io/badge/WoW-Forever-orange?style=for-the-badge)](#requirements)
[![Downloads (this release)](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2Fpowerfulqa%2FWoWClearance%2Fbadge-data%2Flatest.json&style=for-the-badge&color=blue)](https://github.com/powerfulqa/WoWClearance/releases/latest)
[![Downloads (lifetime)](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2Fpowerfulqa%2FWoWClearance%2Fbadge-data%2Fdownloads.json&style=for-the-badge&color=blue)](https://github.com/powerfulqa/WoWClearance/releases)

**Sells and deletes what you don't want, and keeps what you do.** A junk clearer for WoW: Forever: it sells at the vendor, protects the items that matter, and helps you delete or process the rest.

It works with no setup. A guided Quickstart takes one click, and there are detailed controls when you want them.

## Install

1. Download `WoWClearance.zip` from the [releases page](https://github.com/powerfulqa/WoWClearance/releases).
2. Unzip it into your AddOns folder. You end up with two folders, `World of Warcraft/_forever_/Interface/AddOns/WoWClearance` and `WoWClearance_Loot` (the optional Loot module, below).
3. Log in and type `/wc`.

A new character starts with safe defaults: grey items sell, Common and Uncommon gear below what you are wearing sells, and the gear you wear is always kept. Press **Open Quickstart** on the main page to pick a preset or answer a few questions.

To turn it off on one character, untick **Enable WoWClearance**, right-click the minimap button, or type `/wc disable`.

## What it does

### Sells at vendors

- **Grey items** sell at any vendor.
- **Rules per rarity** (Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic). Each can sell gear below what you are wearing in that slot, or below an item level you set, and can be limited to BoE or BoP.
- **Sell Lists.** One per character and one for the whole account. Add an item with Alt+Right-Click, by name or ID, or in bulk by rarity.
- **Recipes you already know** can be sold, per rarity. Each character only sells what it has learned.
- **Repairs** your gear while it sells, from the guild bank if you choose.
- **Speed.** Set the time between sells, or use Fast Mode and Turbo Mode to clear full bags in seconds.
- **Two switches in Merchant Settings:** "Sell items at vendors" stops vendor selling altogether, and "Sell grey items" keeps your greys.

### Keeps what matters

- Gear you are wearing, and gear in your saved equipment sets.
- Gear with an appearance you haven't collected.
- Loot you can still trade to your group or refund.
- Recipes you haven't learned.
- Quest items and profession tools.
- Anything on your **Keep List**.
- Upgrades found in your bags, if you turn that on.

These stop the automatic rules only. An item on your Sell List, or one you chose **Allow Sell** for (Alt+Right-Click), still sells.

The game's own **Sell All Junk** button ignores your Keep List. WoWClearance sells your junk by itself, so you don't need that button.

### Tells you what will happen

Hover an item and its tooltip says **Keep**, **Will Sell**, **Will Delete** or **Won't Sell**, with the reason. Alt+Shift+Right-Click an item, or type `/wc sellinfo`, for a step-by-step explanation.

### Deletes, one press at a time

The game does not let addons delete items on their own. Put items on your **Delete List**, then press **Delete Next** (a button, or a key you bind) to delete one item per press.

In Delete Settings you can also have Delete Next remove grey items once the list is clear, and have unsellable PvP gear and unsellable known recipes added to the list for you. All of those are off until you turn them on.

### Processes your bags

**Process Bags** lists what you can Disenchant, Pick Lock or combine (stacks of motes and similar). Bind a key to **Process Next** and press it to work through them one at a time. Only the skills your character has are shown.

The same panel can **auto-open containers** in your bags.

### Shows what it sold

- **Sold History** (`/wc history`). Everything sold or deleted, newest first, with the rule that decided it.
- **Statistics.** Gold made, items sold and deleted by rarity, repair costs and the last 7 days.
- **Current Rules** (`/wc rules`). Every active rule in plain English.

### Loot module (optional)

`WoWClearance_Loot` comes in the same download as a second addon. It is on by default. Turn it off with the **Loot module** box on the main page or in the game's AddOn list, then reload. Your loot data is kept while it is off.

- **Loot Log** (`/wc loot`, Shift+L). What you looted, how many and what it is worth, for this session, this character or the whole account. The History view lists every pickup, including your group's.
- **Stats - Loot.** Gold looted, gold per hour (this session and your best) and your top farming zones.
- **Stats - Guild.** Pooled totals, best zones and most-sold items from guildmates and group members who also share. Off until you turn it on, and anonymous unless you choose to show your name.

### Highlights your bags

Optional coloured borders show which items will sell or be deleted, or are on a list. Item levels can show on gear in your bags. One switch on the Item Highlighting page, or `/wc highlight`, turns all of it on or off.

### Works with DaylightUI

With the DaylightUI addon installed:

- Its bags show the sell and delete borders, and get Delete List, Sell List, Account Sell List and Keep List groups.
- Its Alt+Right-Click menu carries the WoWClearance rows, so there is one menu instead of two.
- Items you Lock in its bags are never sold, deleted or processed. Items you mark "Sell as junk" are sold.
- Only one addon sells junk at a vendor: its junk sale waits while WoWClearance is selling junk ("Sell items at vendors" and "Sell grey items" both on).
- WoWClearance has a section in its options, a `/dui wc` command, a "Vendored" data text, and windows you can place with `/dui unlock`.

Bag addons that sort items into groups get the borders too.

### Also

- **Alt+Right-Click any bag item** to add it to a list, Allow Sell, see Sell Info or open Sold History.
- **Profiles.** List Profiles save your Sell and Keep lists. Settings Profiles save your selling settings, so alts can share them or keep their own.
- **Import / Export** shares lists or a settings pack as text.
- **Update notice** when someone in your guild or group has a newer version.
- **Help** with a search box, in the settings.

## Commands

| Command | What it does |
|---------|--------------|
| `/wc` | Open the settings |
| `/wc enable`, `/wc disable`, `/wc status` | Turn WoWClearance on or off for this character, or check |
| `/wc loot` | Open the Loot Log |
| `/wc history` | Open Sold History |
| `/wc rules` | Show every active rule |
| `/wc sellinfo` | Explain why an item will or won't sell |
| `/wc highlight` | Turn all item highlighting on or off |
| `/wc profile list\|save\|load\|delete <name>` | List Profiles |
| `/wc sprofile list\|save\|use\|delete <name>` | Settings Profiles |
| `/wc clean` | Find items that are on more than one list (`apply` fixes them) |
| `/wc clean upgrades` | Find old "Upgrade" items on your Keep List (`apply` removes them) |
| `/wc minimap on\|off\|reset` | Show, hide or re-centre the minimap button |
| `/wc bugreport` | Make a report to paste into a bug report |

The main settings page lists every command, including the diagnostic ones, with a button to run each.

**Key bindings** (Key Bindings > WoWClearance): Loot Log (Shift+L by default, if that key is free), settings, turn on or off, Force Sell at the current vendor, Process Next and Delete Next.

## Requirements

- WoW: Forever (Interface 16001).
- No other addons or libraries needed.
- English only.

It is tested on client build 1.60.1.70245. It is an early release: please [report anything odd](https://github.com/powerfulqa/WoWClearance/issues), with the output of `/wc bugreport`.

## Where it came from

WoWClearance is a fork of [EbonClearance](https://github.com/powerfulqa/EbonClearance), the same author's bag manager for WoW 3.3.5a, rewritten for the Forever client. Features that only made sense on EbonClearance's home server were removed.

Ideas and bug reports from that community shaped it. Thanks in particular to Murlocked, ayres, "Perfect Bidoof", Zukii, Qvintus and everyone credited in [EbonClearance's README](https://github.com/powerfulqa/EbonClearance#readme).

Release notes are in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/powerfulqa/WoWClearance/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md). [NOTICE.md](https://github.com/powerfulqa/WoWClearance/blob/master/NOTICE.md) records prior art and design lineage.

## Contributing

Developer documentation is under [docs/](https://github.com/powerfulqa/WoWClearance/blob/master/docs):

- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](https://github.com/powerfulqa/WoWClearance/blob/master/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): which file owns what, on one screen.
- [docs/ADDON_GUIDE.md](https://github.com/powerfulqa/WoWClearance/blob/master/docs/ADDON_GUIDE.md): the working rules, and the traps that have broken things before. Some API notes still describe the 3.3.5a original.
- [docs/PORT_STATUS.md](https://github.com/powerfulqa/WoWClearance/blob/master/docs/PORT_STATUS.md): what the port changed, what is measured in game, and the porting lessons.

The addon is 30 `.lua` files, listed in load order in [WoWClearance.toc](https://github.com/powerfulqa/WoWClearance/blob/master/WoWClearance.toc), plus 6 in the Loot module ([WoWClearance_Loot/](https://github.com/powerfulqa/WoWClearance/blob/master/WoWClearance_Loot)). Before opening a pull request, run:

```
luacheck WoWClearance_*.lua WoWClearance_Loot/*.lua
lua5.1 tests/run_all.lua
```

Luacheck must stay at 0 warnings and all 9 test suites must pass. CI runs the same checks.

AI coding tools: read [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/powerfulqa/WoWClearance/blob/master/AGENTS.md) first.

## Licence

WoWClearance is source-available under its own licence. You may use it, pass on untouched copies (addon packs included) and change your own copy for your own use. You may not share a changed copy, publish a fork or reuse its code in another addon; send fixes and features as pull requests instead. The author credit, the in-game byline and the `LICENSE` file must stay intact. Releases up to v0.8.3 stay under the earlier attribution licence. It may not be used to train or feed AI models, or copied or ported elsewhere by AI agents. The [LICENSE](https://github.com/powerfulqa/WoWClearance/blob/master/LICENSE) file has the full terms.

releases.notes:
### v0.9.1

- **Loot from the missing-realm days is back on your character.** On
  20-21 November, before v0.8.7, the empty realm name made the game save
  some loot under a separate slot. The Account and History views had it,
  but the Character view did not. It is now added to your character
  once, and your best gold per hour keeps the higher record. Your Keep
  and Sell Lists are not touched.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/powerfulqa/WoWClearance/compare/v0.9.0...v0.9.1

### v0.9.0

Loot tracking and guild stats move into an optional module that you can
turn off, and a few extras are gone.

- **New: the Loot module.** The Loot Log, gold looted, gold per hour,
  your top farming zones and Stats - Guild now live in
  `WoWClearance_Loot`, a second addon in the same download. It is on by default, so nothing changes unless you
  turn it off. Turn it off or on with the new **Loot module** box on the
  main page, or in the game's AddOn list, then reload. Your loot data is
  kept while it is off.
- **New page: Stats - Loot.** Gold looted, gold per hour and Top Zones
  moved here from Stats - Personal, with the Loot Log button.
- **Stats - Personal shows what WoWClearance did.** Gold made, items sold
  and deleted, repairs, and Net (gold made minus repairs). The Last 7
  Days rows count the same.
- **Stats - Guild moved to the Loot module.** It works as before: off
  until you tick "Share my farming data with my guild".
- **Removed: Stats - Server.** It shared anonymous totals with the whole
  realm through a chat channel, and is gone along with its switch.
  Update notices from your guild and group still work.
- **Removed: Fast Loot.** Use a looting addon if you want it.
- **Removed: item levels on the character sheet, inspect and vendor
  window.** Item levels on gear in your bags stay (Item Highlighting).
- The Quickstart question about Fast Loot is gone, and the item level
  question is now a plain yes or no for your bags.
- **Your realm shows again.** Since 2026-11-20 the game gives addons an
  empty realm name. Bug reports, Sell Info and the Loot Log showed
  "Name-" with nothing after it, and the Loot Log could mix up your own
  name with a group member's. They now use the realm saved with your
  character's lists.
- **Clearer bug reports.** `/wc bugreport` now says whether the Loot
  module is on and whether you share with your guild, and addon versions
  no longer show as "vv1.2.3".

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/powerfulqa/WoWClearance/compare/v0.8.7...v0.9.0

### v0.8.7

- **No more DaylightUI look.** WoWClearance no longer restyles its own
  windows, settings and Alt+Right-Click menu, and the "Use DaylightUI
  look" switch is gone from the main page and from DaylightUI's options.
  A skin addon can style the windows instead. The rest of the DaylightUI
  support stays: bag borders and groups, the menu row, Lock and junk
  marks, one junk seller, the options section, `/dui wc`, the "Vendored"
  data text and `/dui unlock` window placement.
- **Your lists survive the realm name going missing.** Since 2026-11-20
  the game gives addons an empty realm name. WoWClearance then opened a
  new save slot for each character, filled from an old account-wide copy
  of the lists, so the Keep List could be missing most of its items and
  kept items could be sold. It now goes on using your character's saved
  lists. A slot made in the meantime ("Name-" with no realm) is left in
  the saved data untouched.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/powerfulqa/WoWClearance/compare/v0.8.6...v0.8.7

### v0.8.6

Tidier item tooltips, and licence version 3.

- **No Alt+Right-Click hint with DaylightUI bags.** When DaylightUI's
  bags handle Alt+Right-Click, the WoWClearance hint line is left off
  the tooltip. Their menu already has a WoWClearance row at the top.
- **No second bank count.** The `Bank: N` line is left off when another
  addon already shows bank counts on item tooltips, so the number is not
  shown twice.
- **Licence version 3.** The licence now forbids using the addon to train, fine-tune or evaluate AI models, adding it to AI datasets or indexes, and having AI agents copy or port its code into other software, without the author's written permission. AI help with using or debugging your own copy, or with a pull request, is still fine.
- Copies obtained under licence version 2 stay under version 2.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/powerfulqa/WoWClearance/compare/v0.8.5...v0.8.6

### v0.8.5

A Process Bags fix for rogues.

- **Process Next moves on after a Pick Lock.** After you pick a lockbox,
  the selection now drops to the next box. Before, it could stay on the
  box you had opened, so the next press did nothing.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/powerfulqa/WoWClearance/compare/v0.8.4...v0.8.5
